Method of Attack: Disguised as Chrome and Firefox browser updates on a fake Office 365 site to trick users into downloading a Trojan
Information-stealing Trojan injected into svchost.exe process to avoid detection
Communicates with C2 server to execute modules that steal saved login credentials, browsing history, form autofill information, and upload system information
Impacted Systems: Windows computers running Chrome or Firefox browsers
Attack Vector: Fake Office 365 website prompting fake browser update alerts
Indicators of Compromise: Fake Office 365 site with links pointing to Microsoft domains
Executable file named upd365_58v01.exe downloaded after clicking fake update
